question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e463bc86bc2f582016c689cd03efe86d319c11d65a84c177daf6dad6a87f845.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• **S moves in clockwise direction maintaining space with M.**
 
• **T moves in clockwise direction behind S.**
 
• **M moves in clockwise direction maintaining space with S.**
 
• **N moves in clockwise direction ahead of M.**
 
• **At each step a new alphabet is added.** 

The next step will be [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5a10eff54d698ee5cb23c5fdb5d76446adfa6a3eb7f2b399265cdc22fff367f.png] 

Now we compare the pattern with the given options:

Option 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aca29596d88035b66372fd55fb0721d3d70a4a0dfbf3fa2f6e6d46ca2ac86be0.png] The pattern does not match. This option is incorrect.

Option 2)
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11fbd615c2bd33f535bd85d01c5041c437a84dd513d02ea6afd578b84741d10f.png] The pattern does not match. This option is incorrect.

Option 3)
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89481f2fe29f050acfdcd0cb3050d06db7edd5dcc42e313621b4f1a2ad4abc33.png] The pattern does not match. This option is incorrect.

Option 4)
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa77a43e1eec112bfe18fe8f9a0204b9caeaa6802e61693557158cd7a9224388.png] The pattern matches completely.

**Hence,** **the correct answer is option 4.**
